## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is short-lived and up to date with `main`
- [ ] `composer check` passes (validate, PHPCS, PHPStan, PHPUnit)
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] New or changed user-facing strings are translatable and `languages/` is updated
- [ ] `readme.txt` changelog updated for user-visible changes
